name: Body Ups
how_to:
1. Starting Position
  - Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
  - Keep your feet hip-width apart and maintain a straight line from your head to your heels.
  - Engage your core and glutes to stabilize your body.
2. Execution
  - Press through your forearms and push your upper body upward until your elbows are fully extended.
  - Keep your core tight and maintain control throughout the movement.
  - Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position without collapsing your torso.
  - Repeat for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining proper form.
